root_cause_diagnosis.problem_1: reset_robot() initialized spatial_identity Z height to 0.050m instead of true resting equilibrium 0.05291m, embedding tires in the floor plane and causing explosive contact impulses.
root_cause_diagnosis.problem_2: Freejoints in XML lacked normalized unit quaternions on reset, leading to singular transformation matrices during numerical integration.
root_cause_diagnosis.problem_3: Passive joint stiffness on upper body hinge joints (hip_pitch, hip_roll, neck_sweep) conflicted with active position actuators on tiny masses, causing resonant numerical instability at DOF 27/28.
root_cause_diagnosis.problem_4: Over-constrained 4-point ground contact (front/rear casters + left/right tires at exact same -0.053m height) resulted in hyperstatic wheel slip.

repairs_made.change: Added armature='0.005' to drive wheels and upper-body hinge joints; set joint stiffness to 0.0 with well-conditioned damping (0.5 for hips, 0.2 for neck/head); adjusted caster radius to 0.017m to ensure drive wheels maintain primary normal ground traction; symmetrized ear_R euler angles.
Updated reset_robot() to normalize all freejoint quaternions and set settled ground equilibrium Z=0.05291m.
